purpose: Identify the topic of speech, thought, or investigation.
keywords: Noun + について; noun + についての + noun
I borrowed a book about Japanese history.
formation: Noun + について; noun + についての + noun
restrictions: A broad topic marker, less formal than に関して.
mistake: Use についての before a noun such as 本 or 質問.
